description.p: Telamon Store is the app store of Telamon OS. Browse and search the apps on Flathub and your other Flatpak sources, see their screenshots, what they can access and who made them, and install, update and remove them.

It shows what an app may access before you install it, and never adds a source or installs anything without asking you first. When it is closed, nothing of it runs: Telamon Updater checks for updates in the background.

Telamon's own apps that are not part of the system, such as Telamon Gates, install for you from their GitHub releases, with no Flatpak, and update from the Updates page. Every install asks first and says the app is not sandboxed.
AppImages: the Store notices one you download and offers to install it, with a clear warning that it is not sandboxed, and the Flathub version when there is one.
The Sources and Updates pages work, Home shows popular and new apps, and the category filters are labelled.
